parameters.name: DeploymentType
parameters.description: The deployment type of the SDG. shared: shared read/write splitting deployment. The content of the SDG is read-only, and data updates are written to the local storage of the instance.

parameters.name: DiskAccessProtocol
parameters.description:
The protocol type for disk access:

- iscsi: The default protocol for standard disks. Both RBD disks and standard disks support this protocol.

- rbd: The default protocol for RBD disks. Only RBD disks support this mount protocol.

parameters.name: DiskType
parameters.description:
The disk type of the shared disk to be generated:

- standard (standard disk).

- rbd (RBD disk).

> * If the shared disk type is not specified, a standard disk is generated by default.
>
> * RBD shared disks can be generated only when the source disk type is RBD.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the instances. The value is a JSON array that consists of up to 100 IDs.
